/* AbnormalMapper.selectAbnormalEntryList : 하기이상결과보고 entry List */ SELECT od.HBL_NO ,od.HSN ,od.PIECES AS HBL_PIECES ,od.GWT AS HBL_GWT ,od.DEST_CODE ,od.MBL_NO ,abnormal.PIECES ,abnormal.GWT ,abnormal.ABNORMAL_CODE ,abnormal.CNT ,abnormal.DISC_WH_CODE ,abnormal.AR_DATE ,abnormal.MRN ,abnormal.MSN ,abnormal.VESSEL_FLIGHT ,abnormal.OD_JOB_NO ,abnormal.SEQ_NO_ID ,CASE abnormal.SEQ_NO_ID WHEN 2 THEN 'N' ELSE ISNULL((SELECT 'Y' FROM TB_ECM_OD_ABNORMAL WHERE OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO AND SEQ_NO_ID = 2), 'N') END AS SEND_YN FROM TB_ECM_OD od INNER JOIN TB_ECM_OD_ABNORMAL abnormal ON abnormal.OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO WHERE od.MASTER_OD_JOB_NO = #{srchMasterOdJobNo} AND od.BL_TYPE_MH = 'H'
AND abnormal.ABNORMAL_CODE = #{srchAbnormalCode}

/* AbnormalMapper.selectBmsInPlanAbnormalEntryList : 하기이상결과보고 entry List(반입예정데이터) */ SELECT bip.BL_NO AS HBL_NO ,SUBSTRING(bip.CARGO_REFERENCE_NO, 16, 4) AS HSN ,bip.EX_CT AS HBL_PIECES ,bip.EX_WT AS HBL_GWT ,bip.MBL_NO ,abnormal.PIECES ,abnormal.GWT ,abnormal.ABNORMAL_CODE ,abnormal.CNT ,abnormal.DISC_WH_CODE ,abnormal.AR_DATE ,abnormal.MRN ,abnormal.MSN ,abnormal.VESSEL_FLIGHT ,abnormal.OD_JOB_NO ,abnormal.SEQ_NO_ID ,CASE abnormal.SEQ_NO_ID WHEN 2 THEN 'N' ELSE ISNULL((SELECT 'Y' FROM TB_ECM_OD_ABNORMAL WHERE OD_JOB_NO = CONVERT(VARCHAR(20), bip.IN_PLAN_NO) AND SEQ_NO_ID = 2), 'N') END AS SEND_YN FROM TB_BMS_IN_PLAN bip WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN TB_ECM_OD_ABNORMAL abnormal ON abnormal.OD_JOB_NO = CONVERT(VARCHAR(20), bip.IN_PLAN_NO) WHERE bip.MBL_NO = #{srchMblNo}
AND abnormal.ABNORMAL_CODE = #{srchAbnormalCode}
mapper.insert: /* AbnormalMapper.insertAbnormalList : 하기이상결과보고 insert */ INSERT INTO TB_ECM_OD_ABNORMAL ( OD_JOB_NO , SEQ_NO_ID , ABNORMAL_CODE , MRN , MSN , VESSEL_FLIGHT , DISC_WH_CODE , AR_DATE , PIECES , GWT , CNT , REGISTER_USER_ID , REGISTER_DATE_TIME , UPDATE_USER_ID , UPDATE_DATE_TIME) SELECT od.OD_JOB_NO ,(SELECT ISNULL(MAX(SEQ_NO_ID),0) + 1 FROM TB_ECM_OD_ABNORMAL WHERE OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO ) , #{abnormalCode} , mod.MRN , mod.MSN , mod.VESSEL_FLIGHT , #{discWhCode} , mod.AR_DATE , #{pieces} , #{gwt} , #{cnt} ,#{registerUserId} ,DATEADD(HOUR, ${gmtTime}, GETDATE()) ,#{registerUserId} ,DATEADD(HOUR, ${gmtTime}, GETDATE()) FROM TB_ECM_OD od INNER JOIN TB_ECM_OD mod ON od.MASTER_OD_JOB_NO = mod.OD_JOB_NO WHERE od.OD_JOB_NO = #{odJobNo};
mapper.select:
/* AbnormalMapper.selectAbnormalDeleteCheck : 하기이상결과보고 삭제 전 체크 */ SELECT ab.OD_JOB_NO ,ab.SEQ_NO_ID ,ab.ABNORMAL_CODE
,(SELECT BL_NO FROM TB_BMS_IN_PLAN WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE IN_PLAN_NO = ab.OD_JOB_NO) AS HBL_NO
,(SELECT HBL_NO FROM TB_ECM_OD WHERE OD_JOB_NO = ab.OD_JOB_NO) AS HBL_NO
,(SELECT ISNULL(CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), SEND_DATE, 23), 'N') FROM TB_ECM_OD_ABNORMAL WHERE OD_JOB_NO = ab.OD_JOB_NO AND SEQ_NO_ID = 2) AS MGN_MFN FROM TB_ECM_OD_ABNORMAL ab WHERE (
(ab.OD_JOB_NO = #{item.odJobNo} AND ab.SEQ_NO_ID = #{item.seqNoId})
)
AND ISNULL(ab.SEND_DATE,'') = ''

/* AbnormalMapper.updateLastPodMax : 하기이상결과보고신고 삭제건 last pod update */ UPDATE ad SET LAST_POD_STATUS = pod.POD_STATUS
FROM TB_ECM_OD_ADDITIONAL ad LEFT JOIN ( SELECT TOP 1 A.OD_JOB_NO, A.POD_STATUS, A.POD_DATE, A.POD_TIME FROM( SELECT #{odJobNo} AS OD_JOB_NO, POD_STATUS, POD_DATE, POD_TIME FROM TB_ECM_POD WHERE OD_JOB_NO = (SELECT MASTER_OD_JOB_NO FROM TB_ECM_OD WHERE OD_JOB_NO = #{odJobNo}) AND POD_STATUS IN ('ECM060','ECM070') UNION ALL SELECT #{odJobNo} AS OD_JOB_NO, POD_STATUS, POD_DATE, POD_TIME FROM TB_ECM_POD_01 WHERE OD_JOB_NO = (SELECT MASTER_OD_JOB_NO FROM TB_ECM_OD WHERE OD_JOB_NO = #{odJobNo}) AND POD_STATUS IN ('ECM060','ECM070') UNION ALL SELECT OD_JOB_NO, POD_STATUS, POD_DATE, POD_TIME FROM TB_ECM_POD WHERE OD_JOB_NO = #{odJobNo} AND POD_STATUS NOT IN ('ECM060','ECM070') UNION ALL SELECT OD_JOB_NO, POD_STATUS, POD_DATE, POD_TIME FROM TB_ECM_POD_01 WHERE OD_JOB_NO = #{odJobNo} AND POD_STATUS NOT IN ('ECM060','ECM070') UNION ALL SELECT OD_JOB_NO, POD_STATUS, POD_DATE, POD_TIME FROM TB_ECM_POD_02 WHERE OD_JOB_NO = #{odJobNo} UNION ALL SELECT OD_JOB_NO, POD_STATUS, POD_DATE, POD_TIME FROM TB_ECM_POD_03 WHERE OD_JOB_NO = #{odJobNo} UNION ALL SELECT OD_JOB_NO, POD_STATUS, POD_DATE, POD_TIME FROM TB_ECM_POD_04 WHERE OD_JOB_NO = #{odJobNo} AND POD_STATUS IN ('ECM400', 'ECM420') ) A ORDER BY A.POD_STATUS DESC ) pod ON pod.OD_JOB_NO = ad.OD_JOB_NO WHERE ad.OD_JOB_NO = #{odJobNo}
mapper.insert: /* AbnormalMapper.insertSpecialItem : 별도관리물품 insert */ INSERT INTO TB_ECM_OD_SPECIAL_ITEM ( OD_JOB_NO , SEQ_NO_ID , MANAGE_TYPE , AR_DATE , FLIGHT_NO , DEST_PORT , PIECES , ITEM_DESC , GWT ) SELECT #{odJobNo} ,(SELECT ISNULL(MAX(SEQ_NO_ID),0) + 1 FROM TB_ECM_OD_SPECIAL_ITEM WHERE OD_JOB_NO = #{odJobNo} ) , '2' , od.AR_DATE , od.VESSEL_FLIGHT , od.DEST_PORT , od.PIECES , od.COMMODITY_ITEM , od.GWT FROM TB_ECM_OD od WHERE od.OD_JOB_NO = #{mfnOdJobNo}

/* AbnormalMapper.insertMblCorrectByAb : 적하정정 insert */ INSERT INTO TB_EDI_MOD_MBL( MOD_JOB_NO ,ENT_CODE ,ENT_BUSINESS_CODE ,SOLUTION ,BOUND ,MRN ,MSN ,MBL_NO ,MOD_TYPE ,HBL_CNT ,MOD_SERIAL_NO ,MOD_REQ_NO ,MOD_REQ_DATE ,CUSTOMS_CODE ,CUSTOMS_DPT_CODE ,REGISTER_USER_ID ,REGISTER_DATE_TIME ) SELECT TOP 1 #{modJobNo} ,od.ENT_CODE ,od.ENT_BUSINESS_CODE ,#{solution} ,od.BOUND ,od.MRN ,od.MSN ,od.MBL_NO ,#{modType} ,#{hblCnt} ,#{modSerialNo} ,#{modReqNo} ,DATEADD(HOUR, ${gmtTime}, GETDATE()) ,CASE WHEN od.BOUND_TYPE = 'EXP' THEN code.ETC3 ELSE code.ETC7 END ,CASE WHEN od.BOUND_TYPE = 'EXP' THEN code.ETC4 ELSE code.ETC8 END ,#{registerUserId} ,DATEADD(HOUR, ${gmtTime}, GETDATE()) FROM TB_ECM_OD od LEFT JOIN TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL code ON code.ENT_CODE = od.ENT_CODE AND code.GROUP_CODE = 'ECM_CUSTOMS_DPT' AND code.CODE = CASE WHEN od.BOUND_TYPE = 'EXP' THEN od.ORIG_CODE ELSE od.DEST_CODE END WHERE od.MBL_NO = LTRIM(RTRIM(REPLACE(#{mblNo},char(9),''))) AND od.BL_TYPE_MH = 'M'

/* AbnormalMapper.selectAbnormalHouseList : 정정데이터 생성할 하우스 조회 */
WITH TMP AS( SELECT od.OD_JOB_NO ,od.HBL_NO ,od.HSN ,cntr.CNTR_NO FROM TB_ECM_OD od INNER JOIN TB_ECM_OD_CONTAINER cntr ON cntr.OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO
AND cntr.CNTR_NO = #{cntrNo}
AND cntr.CNTR_NO IN (#{item.cntrNo})
WHERE od.MASTER_OD_JOB_NO = #{masterOdJobNo} AND od.BL_TYPE_MH = 'H'
WHERE od.OD_JOB_NO IN (#{item.odJobNo})
) SELECT t.OD_JOB_NO ,MAX(t.HBL_NO) AS HBL_NO ,MAX(t.HSN) AS HSN ,STUFF((SELECT '|' + CNTR_NO FROM TMP WHERE OD_JOB_NO = t.OD_JOB_NO FOR XML PATH('')), 1, 1, '') AS CNTR_NO_LIST FROM TMP t GROUP BY t.OD_JOB_NO
SELECT od.OD_JOB_NO ,od.HBL_NO ,od.HSN
,od.VESSEL_FLIGHT ,od.VOYAGE ,od.DEST_CODE ,od.AR_DATE ,od.SHIPPER_NAME ,CONCAT(ISNULL(od.SHIPPER_ADDRESS, ''), ISNULL(od.SHIPPER_ADDRESS_A, ''), ISNULL(od.SHIPPER_ADDRESS_B, ''), ISNULL(od.SHIPPER_ADDRESS_C, ''), ISNULL(od.SHIPPER_ADDRESS_D, '')) AS SHIPPER_ADDRESS ,od.SHIPPER_TEL ,od.CONSIGNEE_NAME ,CONCAT(ISNULL(od.CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS, ''), ISNULL(od.CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS_A, ''), ISNULL(od.CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS_B, ''), ISNULL(od.CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS_C, ''), ISNULL(od.CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS_D, '')) AS CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS ,dbo.Cryptography(od.OD_JOB_NO, od.CONSIGNEE_BUSINESS_ID, 1) AS CONSIGNEE_BUSINESS_ID ,od.COMMODITY_ITEM ,od.UNIT_PIECES ,od.GWT
,dbo.Cryptography(od.OD_JOB_NO, od.CONSIGNEE_TEL_ENC, 1) AS CONSIGNEE_TEL
,od.CONSIGNEE_TEL
FROM TB_ECM_OD od
WHERE od.MASTER_OD_JOB_NO = #{masterOdJobNo} AND od.BL_TYPE_MH = 'H'
WHERE od.OD_JOB_NO IN (#{item.odJobNo})

/* AbnormalMapper.selectAbnormalCntrInfo : 정정데이터 생성할 컨테이너 조회 */ SELECT TOP 1 MAX(cntr.CNTR_NO) AS CNTR_NO ,COUNT(cntr.OD_JOB_NO) AS CNTR_CNT
FROM TB_ECM_OD od INNER JOIN TB_ECM_OD_CONTAINER cntr ON cntr.OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO WHERE od.MASTER_OD_JOB_NO = #{masterOdJobNo} AND od.BL_TYPE_MH = 'H'
FROM TB_ECM_OD_CONTAINER cntr
WHERE cntr.OD_JOB_NO = #{odJobNo}
WHERE cntr.OD_JOB_NO IN (#{item})
WHERE cntr.OD_JOB_NO IN (#{item.odJobNo})
AND cntr.CNTR_NO IN(#{item})
AND cntr.CNTR_NO IN(#{item})
GROUP BY cntr.OD_JOB_NO ORDER BY CNTR_CNT DESC

/* AbnormalMapper.selectAbnormalCntrInfoList : 정정데이터 생성할 컨테이너 조회 */ SELECT cntr.CNTR_NO ,cntr.OD_JOB_NO
FROM TB_ECM_OD od INNER JOIN TB_ECM_OD_CONTAINER cntr ON cntr.OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO WHERE od.MASTER_OD_JOB_NO = #{masterOdJobNo} AND od.BL_TYPE_MH = 'H'
FROM TB_ECM_OD_CONTAINER cntr
WHERE cntr.OD_JOB_NO = #{odJobNo}
WHERE cntr.OD_JOB_NO IN (#{item})
WHERE cntr.OD_JOB_NO IN (#{item.odJobNo})
AND cntr.CNTR_NO IN(#{item}) ORDER BY cntr.OD_JOB_NO

/* AbnormalMapper.selectAbnormalChk : 하기이상저장 전 체크 */ SELECT od.MBL_NO ,od.MASTER_OD_JOB_NO ,hod.HBL_NO ,hod.OD_JOB_NO
,(SELECT TOP 1 OD_JOB_NO FROM TB_ECM_OD_ABNORMAL WHERE OD_JOB_NO = hod.OD_JOB_NO AND ABNORMAL_CODE NOT IN('MGN','SHT')) AS ABNORMAL_CODE_DUP
,(SELECT TOP 1 OD_JOB_NO FROM TB_ECM_OD_ABNORMAL WHERE OD_JOB_NO = hod.OD_JOB_NO) AS ABNORMAL_CODE_DUP
,(SELECT ISNULL(MAX(HSN), 0) FROM TB_ECM_OD WHERE MASTER_OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO AND BL_TYPE_MH = 'H') AS MAX_HSN FROM TB_ECM_OD od LEFT JOIN TB_ECM_OD hod ON hod.MBL_NO = od.MBL_NO AND hod.HBL_NO = LTRIM(RTRIM(#{HBL_NO}))
WHERE od.MBL_NO = LTRIM(RTRIM(#{MBL_NO}))
WHERE od.OD_JOB_NO = #{odJobNo}
AND od.BL_TYPE_MH = 'M'
AND od.BOUND_TYPE = 'IMP'

/* AbnormalMapper.selectBmsInPlanAbnormalChk : 하기이상저장 전 체크(반입예정데이터) */ SELECT TOP 1 bip.MBL_NO ,bip.BL_NO AS HBL_NO ,bip.IN_PLAN_NO AS OD_JOB_NO
,(SELECT TOP 1 OD_JOB_NO FROM TB_ECM_OD_ABNORMAL WHERE OD_JOB_NO = CONVERT(VARCHAR(20), bip.IN_PLAN_NO) AND ABNORMAL_CODE NOT IN('MGN','SHT')) AS ABNORMAL_CODE_DUP
,(SELECT TOP 1 OD_JOB_NO FROM TB_ECM_OD_ABNORMAL WHERE OD_JOB_NO = CONVERT(VARCHAR(20), bip.IN_PLAN_NO)) AS ABNORMAL_CODE_DUP
FROM TB_BMS_IN_PLAN bip WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE bip.BL_NO = LTRIM(RTRIM(#{HBL_NO}))
AND bip.MBL_NO = LTRIM(RTRIM(#{MBL_NO}))
ORDER BY bip.REGISTER_DATE_TIME DESC

/* abnormalMapper.selectHouseList : 마스터로 하우스 리스트 조회 */ SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY HSN) AS SEQ , A.OD_JOB_NO AS odJobNo , A.HBL_NO AS hblNo , A.HSN AS hsn FROM( SELECT od.OD_JOB_NO , od.HBL_NO , od.HSN FROM TB_ECM_OD od INNER JOIN TB_ECM_OD_ADDITIONAL ad ON od.OD_JOB_NO = ad.OD_JOB_NO WHERE od.MASTER_OD_JOB_NO = #{odJobNo} AND od.BL_TYPE_MH = 'H'
) A

/* abnormalMapper.selectHouseListMgnMfn : MGN or SHT후 MFN생성가능한 데이터 조회 */ SELECT A.OD_JOB_NO AS odJobNo, A.HBL_NO AS hblNo, A.PIECES AS pieces FROM ( SELECT od.OD_JOB_NO ,MAX(od.HBL_NO) AS HBL_NO ,MAX(od.PIECES) AS PIECES ,MIN(ab.ABNORMAL_CODE) AS ABNORMAL_CODE_MIN FROM TB_ECM_OD od INNER JOIN TB_ECM_OD_ADDITIONAL ad ON od.OD_JOB_NO = ad.OD_JOB_NO INNER JOIN TB_ECM_OD_ABNORMAL ab ON od.OD_JOB_NO = ab.OD_JOB_NO AND ab.ABNORMAL_CODE IN('MGN', 'SHT', 'MFN') WHERE od.MASTER_OD_JOB_NO = #{masterOdJobNo} AND od.BL_TYPE_MH = 'H'
GROUP BY od.OD_JOB_NO ) A WHERE A.ABNORMAL_CODE_MIN != 'MFN'
mapper.update:
UPDATE TB_ECM_OD_ADDITIONAL SET ABNORMAL_DATE = DATEADD(HOUR, ${gmtTime}, GETDATE()) ,LAST_POD_STATUS = CASE WHEN ISNULL(LAST_POD_STATUS, '') < 'ECM160' THEN 'ECM160' ELSE LAST_POD_STATUS END
,UNMANAGEMENT_DATE = DATEADD(HOUR, ${gmtTime}, GETDATE())
WHERE OD_JOB_NO IN ( SELECT od.OD_JOB_NO FROM TB_ECM_OD od
WHERE od.OD_JOB_NO IN (#{item})
INNER JOIN TB_ECM_OD_ADDITIONAL ad ON ad.OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO WHERE od.MASTER_OD_JOB_NO = #{masterOdJobNo} AND od.BL_TYPE_MH = 'H'
WHERE od.OD_JOB_NO = #{odJobNo}
)
